title: Firmware changed after signing
likelihood_rationale: Attacker model allows modifying traffic; no key needed to alter bytes
impact_rationale: Malicious code on an ECU defeats the project claim and may reach actuators
prevention: SHA-256 check at gateway and again at ECU before staging
detection: DIGEST_MISMATCH / BAD_SIGNATURE audit event with correlation ID
recovery: No state change; retry from repository
residual_risk: None at simulation level

title: Signature by unknown or revoked key
likelihood_rationale: Rogue keys are cheap to generate; revocation lists can lag
impact_rationale: Accepting attacker metadata gives full firmware control
prevention: Trusted key set and revoked key_id list
residual_risk: Trusted-key update procedure is S3 key-lifecycle work

title: Previously valid metadata replayed
likelihood_rationale: Captured metadata is easy to resend
impact_rationale: Can re-push a superseded image or block progress
prevention: Monotonic metadata_version per ECU stored durably
residual_risk: Counter reset on gateway storage wipe not covered

title: Older valid firmware offered (downgrade)
likelihood_rationale: Old signed releases remain valid signatures forever
impact_rationale: Reintroduces known vulnerabilities
prevention: trusted_min_version checked at gateway and ECU; raised only on confirmation
residual_risk: None at simulation level

title: Artifact targets another ECU or hardware revision
likelihood_rationale: Valid images for other ECUs exist and are signed
impact_rationale: Wrong image can brick the ECU
prevention: ecu_id + hardware_id binding at gateway and ECU
residual_risk: None at simulation level

title: Metadata from different campaigns mixed
likelihood_rationale: Needs control of the instruction channel
impact_rationale: Inconsistent multi-ECU versions
prevention: All envelopes checked against bundle campaign before any download
residual_risk: Cross-ECU dependency rules deferred (T-12)

title: Expired metadata after clock manipulation
likelihood_rationale: Requires control of the time source
impact_rationale: Stale but still signed instructions accepted
prevention: expires_at compared to trusted clock
residual_risk: Secure-time source is an assumption (A-TIME) owned by S3

title: Download truncated oversized or endless
likelihood_rationale: Trivial to cut or pad a stream
impact_rationale: Memory or flash exhaustion; partial image
prevention: Declared-length cap before download; byte cap while reading; exact length check
residual_risk: None at simulation level

title: Download intentionally slowed
likelihood_rationale: Slow-drip is trivial
impact_rationale: Update delayed; gateway resources held
prevention: Stall and total timeouts
residual_risk: Real socket timeouts needed in implementation

title: Operator performs an unauthorized privileged action
likelihood_rationale: Operators hold real credentials; misconfigured roles are a common failure
impact_rationale: An unapproved campaign or release could reach vehicles
prevention: Authorization matrix checked before every action
detection: DENIED audit event with actor and correlation ID
recovery: No state change; transaction rolled back
residual_risk: An insider acting inside their own role is detected (audit) but not prevented

title: Vehicle version manifest modified
likelihood_rationale: Manifest crosses the hostile network
impact_rationale: Backend targets wrong versions or misses a failed update
prevention: Manifest signed with vehicle key
recovery: Backend rejects the manifest and keeps the last accepted inventory
residual_risk: Vehicle key protection is simulated only

title: Dependency cycle declared across ECU versions
likelihood_rationale: Needs operator access or a configuration mistake
impact_rationale: Campaign can never complete; vehicles stay on mixed versions
prevention: Topological ordering of campaign ECUs at creation
residual_risk: Cross-campaign dependencies are not modelled

title: Network disconnects during download
likelihood_rationale: Mobile links drop often
impact_rationale: Delay only if handled
prevention: Nothing staged until full verified download
recovery: Restart download from zero; replay counter not advanced
residual_risk: Resume-from-offset not implemented

title: Gateway terminates during state transition
likelihood_rationale: Crashes and resets happen
impact_rationale: Gateway and ECU bookkeeping could disagree
prevention: Atomic writes; ECU stage is idempotent
residual_risk: None at simulation level

title: Power fails during staging or commit
likelihood_rationale: Vehicles lose power during updates
impact_rationale: Unbootable ECU
prevention: Inactive-slot writes; temp file + atomic rename; intent record
recovery: Recovery returns to IDLE or STAGED with old slot bootable
residual_risk: Real flash wear and partial-sector writes not modelled

title: New image fails health confirmation
likelihood_rationale: Bad builds ship
impact_rationale: ECU stuck on broken firmware
prevention: Confirmed slot kept until positive health
residual_risk: None at simulation level

title: Vehicle moves before activation
likelihood_rationale: Drivers start moving at any time
impact_rationale: Reboot of an ECU while driving is a safety hazard
prevention: Safety policy gate in ECU activate
recovery: Stay STAGED and retry when safe
residual_risk: Real vehicle-state signal authenticity not modelled

title: Malicious CAN peer sends unsolicited activation or confirmation
likelihood_rationale: Requires a foothold on the vehicle network
impact_rationale: Could commit an untested image
prevention: State machine accepts commands only in matching state
residual_risk: Gateway-to-ECU message authentication not modelled (in-process calls); architecture-phase decision needed

title: Compromised ECU reports false version or state
likelihood_rationale: Requires ECU compromise
impact_rationale: Backend believes a stale ECU is updated
prevention: Gateway reports only state read from ECU store
detection: Backend rejects incomplete or inconsistent manifests (MANIFEST_INCOMPLETE / MANIFEST_INCONSISTENT)
residual_risk: Accepted for this phase; ECU attestation out of scope

title: Flash corruption of the staged image
likelihood_rationale: Bit flips and wear occur
impact_rationale: Corrupt image activated
prevention: Digest re-check before slot switch
recovery: Old slot stays active; next update re-stages
residual_risk: None at simulation level

title: Boot manipulation of the newly activated image
likelihood_rationale: Needs write access to inactive storage
impact_rationale: Unverified code runs
prevention: Digest check at boot while INSTALLED
residual_risk: Secure boot of the confirmed image is out of scope

title: Spoofed or invalid vehicle safety inputs
likelihood_rationale: Sensor messages are easy to forge or garble
impact_rationale: Activation while moving
prevention: Invalid or non-finite inputs treated as unsafe
residual_risk: Authenticity of real sensor inputs not modelled

title: API caller spoofs an identity with a stolen or forged credential
likelihood_rationale: Credentials leak through laptops and CI logs; forging needs no key
impact_rationale: Attacker acts as an operator or as another vehicle
prevention: Token authentication; vehicle identity bound to its vehicle_id
recovery: Revoke the credential; no state change on rejection
residual_risk: A stolen valid token works until revoked; prototype tokens have no expiry or rotation

title: Release creator approves their own release
likelihood_rationale: Small teams often hold both roles
impact_rationale: Unreviewed firmware gets signed and offered
prevention: Approver must differ from creator, checked by backend and again by signing service
detection: DENIED audit event; REFUSED_SELF_APPROVAL in key usage log
residual_risk: Two colluding insiders can still approve each other's releases

title: Artifact replaced in backend object storage after signing
likelihood_rationale: Object storage is online and broadly accessible
impact_rationale: Malicious firmware offered to the whole fleet
prevention: Signed digest and length checked at gateway and again at ECU
detection: DIGEST_MISMATCH vehicle event and REJECTED assignment, same correlation ID
recovery: Nothing staged; restore the artifact from the release record
residual_risk: None at simulation level

title: Campaign or assignment records modified in the database
likelihood_rationale: Database credentials are a frequent target
impact_rationale: Vehicles retargeted to other versions or ECUs
prevention: Offers are signed from approved release records; gateway verifies every signed field
residual_risk: An attacker who controls both the database and the online signing path can sign altered content; offline image signing is a Phase 3 decision

title: Audit evidence modified or deleted
likelihood_rationale: Insiders have motive to hide actions
impact_rationale: Unauthorized actions cannot be proven; research evidence loses credibility
prevention: Append-only API and SHA-256 hash chain
detection: verify() reports the first broken sequence; head hash compared with exported anchor
residual_risk: A full chain rebuild is detected only if the anchor is stored where the attacker cannot write

title: API resource exhaustion through oversized uploads
likelihood_rationale: Large bodies cost nothing to send
impact_rationale: Backend memory or storage exhausted; campaigns delayed
prevention: Content-Length and body size limit before storage
residual_risk: No request-rate limiting in the prototype

title: Sensitive data disclosed in error responses or logs
likelihood_rationale: Stack traces and debug messages leak by default in web frameworks
impact_rationale: Credential or key exposure leads to wider compromise
prevention: Fixed error messages; generic INTERNAL handler; audit field denylist
detection: Secret scan of evidence and logs
residual_risk: Third-party library logs outside the prototype are not scanned

title: Event reports replayed or duplicated
likelihood_rationale: Gateways retry on timeouts; captured reports are easy to resend
impact_rationale: Assignment state wrong; campaign metrics false
prevention: event_id idempotency, metadata_version binding and transition table
recovery: Original result returned; no state change
residual_risk: Event reports are authenticated by token only, not signed by the vehicle key

title: Private key or credential committed to source control
likelihood_rationale: A common developer mistake, made permanent by git history
impact_rationale: Any reader of the repository can sign firmware
prevention: Keys generated in memory or stored encrypted outside the tree; .gitignore for key files
recovery: Revoke the key through a new key set and rewrite history
residual_risk: Pattern-based scan cannot find every secret format

title: Release key used to sign an unapproved release
likelihood_rationale: Needs access to the signing interface
impact_rationale: Arbitrary firmware signed with a trusted key
prevention: Signing service checks approval state, separation of duties and payload equality
residual_risk: The signing service trusts the approval record it is given; production needs approver signatures or threshold signing

title: Trusted key set replaced or rolled back
likelihood_rationale: Key set updates cross the hostile network
impact_rationale: Attacker keys become trusted on the vehicle
prevention: Root signature, monotonic version and expiry on every key set
recovery: Vehicle keeps its current key set
residual_risk: Root key compromise and root rotation are out of scope (ASM-07)

title: Release signing key compromised
likelihood_rationale: Online keys are exposed to server compromise
impact_rationale: Attacker metadata verifies until the key is revoked
prevention: Revocation by publishing a higher key set version
recovery: Revoke and rotate; re-sign pending offers with the new key
residual_risk: Window between compromise and revocation; offline vehicles keep the old set

title: Key used outside its authorized role
likelihood_rationale: Shared keys across roles are a common shortcut
impact_rationale: A vehicle or root key could authorize firmware
prevention: One role per key; gateway trusts release-role keys only
residual_risk: None at simulation level
